blocks.label: Subject
blocks.body: Photograph of a retired boxer taping his hands in a basement gym, basement gym at 6am, condensation on the windows.

blocks.label: Camera
blocks.body: Framed as a medium close-up on an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8.

blocks.label: Finish
blocks.body: Captured on Kodak Portra 400 and graded desaturated earth tones in a palette of #0B3D2E deep green, warm brass, bone white.

blocks.label: Composition & mood
blocks.body: Composed using rule of thirds. The mood is austere.

blocks.label: In-image text
blocks.body: The words "NORTHBOUND SUPPLY CO" rendered cleanly, high contrast against the background, correctly spelled.

blocks.label: Reference
blocks.body: In the register of Roger Deakins night exteriors.

blocks.label: Intended use
blocks.body: For Instagram carousel, first slide, keep the focal subject clear of the outer eighth of the frame.

settings.name: endpoint
settings.why: [pro] for default quality, [flex] when you need steps and guidance

notes: The text encoder is a Mistral-3 VLM, so it follows structured multi-part instructions well. Detail is rewarded, not diluted.
[klein] at 4B is Apache 2.0 and runs in about 8GB of VRAM: the right free local recommendation now, ahead of SDXL.
warnings: [pro] and [max] deliberately expose no steps and no guidance. If you need those dials you must switch to [flex].
prompt_upsampling rewrites your prompt with an LLM. Leave it off once the prompt is engineered.

variations.name: Colder, more documentary
variations.text: Swap the grade for desaturated earth tones, drop to available light only, and shoot it on a 35mm at f/2.8. Same subject, no styling.

variations.name: Tighter and more graphic
variations.text: Go to an extreme close-up on the single most telling detail. Hard directional light, deep shadow, generous negative space around it.

variations.name: Wider, with context
variations.text: Pull back to an establishing wide. Put the subject small in the frame and let the setting carry the story. Keep the same light and grade.
